## The question

**In one or two short paragraphs, introduce the setting, audience, 
focused research question, data source, observational unit, response, 
important predictors, and one important data limitation. 
Lead with what makes the question worth answering.**

Our overall question is: which predictors in the dataset are the best 
at predicting final grades in secondary education in Portuguese schools? 
We would also like to investigate specific relationships, such as that 
between student’s relationships (familial and friends) and their final 
grade in math. The intended audience is both educators and students in 
secondary Portuguese education. The answer matters because student 
performance is related to their ability to get jobs and contribute 
to their communities in the future. The response for this question is 
the student’s final grade, which ranges from 0 to 20 numerically. A 
few important candidate predictors for this question would be the 
number of absences, age, quality of family relationships and time 
spent going out with friends.
